entries.zh: 陆路（西语词头作“水路或……”，疑为一组“水路/陆路”对举词条之残段；汉字仅存“陆”）
entries.en: road by land (Spanish head reads 'way by water, or…', likely paired with water route; Chinese gives only 陸 'land')
entries.notes: 西语词头言水路而汉字作“陆”，两栏相抵，判为一组对举词条的残段。

entries.zh: 陆路；旱路（汉字作“横”，音写含“旱路”等，另一段音写污损）
entries.en: overland road; dry (inland) route (Chinese character reads 橫 'crosswise', manuscript partly smudged)
entries.notes: T99 污损难辨，且汉字“横”与音写“han lou（旱路）”义不合，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 歪；斜穿的窄路（斜路、斜径）
entries.en: crooked/slanting; a narrow path crossing aslant (camino atravesado estrecho)

entries.zh: 偏离大路的岔径（“乖”，偏斜离道；汉字“歌”疑为“乖”之误）
entries.en: a way straying off the main road (‘off-course’, Chinese 歌 likely an error for 乖 'deviant/askew')
entries.notes: 西语词头“Camino fuera camabroy os.”抄写残乱，汉字有 [疑]，义项凭“乖（偏离）”推定。

entries.zh: 路上；在途中
entries.en: on the road; en route (路上)

entries.zh: 陆路；旱行的道路
entries.en: land road; overland route (陸路)

entries.zh: 旱路；不经水道的陆行道路
entries.en: dry (inland) road; route by land as opposed to by water (旱路)

entries.zh: 起旱；改走陆路（由水路转陆行）
entries.en: to set out overland; to take to the land route (起旱)

entries.zh: 路熟；走熟的路（熟悉之路）
entries.en: a road one knows well; familiar route (路熟)

entries.zh: 岭路；翻山越岭的道路
entries.en: mountain-pass road; route over the ridges (嶺路)

entries.zh: 圳岸；沿沟圳（水渠）岸边可行走的堤道、田塍路
entries.en: path along the bank of an irrigation channel/ditch (圳岸, orilla del canal)

entries.zh: 潭岸；潭边（河岸）高处可行走的岸堤
entries.en: bank/ledge of a pool or river (潭岸, ribazo)
entries.notes: 闽南语声调栏一处 T99 污损难辨，依材料不足降置信。

entries.zh: 趁路去；沿路走、取道而行
entries.en: to go by way of the road; to take the route (趁路去)

entries.zh: 引道；引人引路之道（西语残句谓“奉主使者之命而无从之路”，义存疑）
entries.en: a guided/led way (引道); Spanish gloss garbled, 'by order of the overseer…', sense uncertain
entries.notes: 西语词头 d.o 缩写展开且句残， 义项以汉字“引道”为主。

entries.zh: 道多路；道路多、路路相连（多条路并走）
entries.en: many roads close together; the ways are numerous (道多路)
entries.notes: 西语“Camino mucho junto”义含糊， 义项依汉字与音写推定。

entries.zh: 路湾；绕弯之路、迂回路
entries.en: bend in the road; winding/detouring route (路灣)

entries.zh: 弯亏路；迂曲绕远之路（“亏”疑为“曲”，曲折绕行的路）
entries.en: winding, roundabout road (Chinese 亏 likely an error for 曲 'bent'; van-guiok-lou)
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注 [疑:亏/曲]，义项取“迂曲绕行”。

entries.zh: 衬衫；衬里之衣（汉字“称”疑为“衬”）
entries.en: shirt; undergarment with lining (Chinese 稱 likely an error for 襯 'lining')
entries.notes: 汉字“称”与西语 Camisa（衬衫）不相应，疑为“衬”之讹，官话栏尚有“au.”残字。

entries.zh: 衬衫；衬里的衣衫
entries.en: shirt; lined garment/shirt (襯衫, with the character 稱 again likely for 襯)
entries.notes: 同上条：“称衫”之“称”疑为“衬”讹字，音写含衫（sa）可证为衣类。

entries.zh: 内衣；贴身穿的里衣
entries.en: inner garment; underwear (內衣, camisa interior)
